The observed binding of Norethindrone to Shbg indicates a direct interaction that may influence the function of this steroid-binding protein. The presence of a common ancestor, 3-Oxo-Delta(4) Steroid, suggests a shared metabolic pathway, further supporting the notion of a coordinated regulatory role. The final scores from the two paths indicate a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, though the evidence is not definitive. The mechanism appears to involve progestin-induced modulation of Shbg, potentially through hormonal signaling pathways.
